data.group: Daemon Prince of Tzeentch with Wings
data.summary: When you deploy this Daemon Prince via [Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike) in your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), you can set it up farther than 6″ from every enemy unit. Taking this option prevents it from declaring a charge that turn and grants Dark Blessing **[[SUSTAINED HITS D3]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)** for the remainder of that turn.

detail.actor: Daemon Prince of Tzeentch with Wings
detail.trigger: set up on battlefield using Deep Strike in own Movement phase
